tools: GitHub CLI (gh), signed in, for pull requests, reviews and issues; without it the update is built from git alone

presentation.name: Write a daily standup update from your actual activity
presentation.summary: Drafts a daily standup or status update from commits, pull requests and reviews since the last working day.
benefits: Builds Done from git history and GitHub activity rather than from memory
Covers the whole period since the last working day, so Monday's update includes Friday
States each blocker with its owner and since when, or says there are none
Asks about meetings and investigations instead of inventing activity
